pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account is waiting for approval. An admin has been notified; you can come back later.

disabled.title: Account unavailable
disabled.body: Your account is disabled or is being deleted. Contact an admin if you think this is a mistake.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.body: You are not allowed to see this page.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.idpNote: Your name and email come from your identity provider.
profile.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Type your name to confirm.
profile.dangerBody: Deletes your account and everything you own in postit. This cannot be undone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose how postit tells you about your posts and accounts.

push.label: Notifications in this browser
push.hint: Shows a notice on this device even when postit is closed.
push.blocked: Blocked. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings, then reload this page.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications from postit.
push.serverOff: Push notifications are not enabled on this server.
push.failed: Couldn't turn notifications on. Try again.

email.label: Email me about activity
email.hint: The master switch for every email below.

digest.label: Daily comment digest
digest.hint: One email each morning at 8 a.m. in your time zone with new comments.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: Times and the digest follow this zone.
timezone.detected: Detected from your browser. Save it to use it for times and the digest.
